## DeWalt DCB184 18v XR Cordless Li-ion Battery 5ah

The DeWalt DCB184 is an 18V XR lithium-ion battery pack designed to deliver extended runtime for professional tradespeople using the DeWalt 18V XR cordless tool platform. This 5.0Ah battery provides 66% more runtime compared to a standard 3.0Ah pack, allowing contractors and tradesmen to work longer between charges on demanding applications.

Despite the increased capacity, this battery maintains the same compact dimensions and 0.62kg weight as the 3.0Ah version, ensuring tools remain well-balanced and comfortable during extended use. The integrated LED state of charge indicator allows users to quickly check remaining power levels, helping to plan work and manage charging schedules more effectively throughout the working day.

Built with lithium-ion technology that eliminates memory effect and virtually eliminates self-discharge, the DCB184 delivers consistent performance with minimal downtime. Advanced protection systems guard against overheat, overload and deep discharge conditions to maximise battery lifespan. This battery is fully compatible with all DeWalt 18V XR Li-Ion cordless tools, making it an ideal upgrade for electricians, carpenters, plumbers and general contractors already invested in the XR platform.

**Features and Benefits:**  
• Delivers 66% more runtime than a standard 3.0Ah battery pack  
• LED State of Charge Indicator helps manage pack charging  
• Upgraded 5Ah power without increasing size or weight over the 18V 3Ah battery  
• No memory effect and virtually no self-discharge for maximum productivity and less downtime  
• Compatible with all 18V XR Li-Ion DeWalt tools  
• Protection against overheat, overload and deep discharge conditions increases battery life

**Specifications:**  
Battery Capacity: 5.0 Ah  
Voltage: 18 V  
Height: 65mm  
Length: 110mm  
Weight: 0.62kg

### This item includes the following promotional items :

Battery Voltage Explained

A tool with a higher voltage than another is a bit like choosing an engine in a car, the higher voltage will generally mean higher power & performance. As with cars though a bigger engine does not always translate to better performance so it is important to compare the specifications of tools at different voltages between different manufacturers.

Battery AH Explained

The best way to describe battery amp hour is that this is effectively the size of your fuel tank, the more amp hours your battery has then the longer the battery will last between charges. More amp hours does not increase the power of a given tool.
